example_quality.summary: A fictional manager for the demo. It says it owns a small number of businesses with high returns on capital and wide margins, bought at a fair price and held for many years.

tests.words: Returns on capital above 15%, well above the cost of capital
High gross margins as a sign of pricing power
A fair price on free cash flow

theses.title: Payments keep moving to cards
theses.words: The letter says cash keeps giving way to card payments abroad, which the network earns on with little extra cost.
